long_biography.plain_text:
At Owl Creek, Jeffrey Altman has made complex corporate change his investment terrain. The firm takes positions across credit and equities when restructurings, spin-offs or other dislocations create a gap between market price and underlying value. Its strategy reflects experience he acquired at Franklin Mutual, where he worked as an analyst, trader and portfolio manager in distressed securities. His own funds extended that approach across international markets and specialised credit opportunities.

Altman also serves on the board of Anterix, a communications company in which Owl Creek has been a significant investor. His Tulane education has had a lasting philanthropic counterpart: through his foundation he helped establish a dual-degree programme combining business, international studies and language learning. The programme supports overseas study and practical experience for students pursuing a global perspective.

uncertainties.detail: Forbes publishes an exact-person interview and conference listing, not a dedicated profile. A Coaches Council result is an unrelated same-name career coach. The proposed individual LinkedIn matches Owl Creek and Tulane; searches did not verify a personal Instagram, personal site, Facebook, X, YouTube or TikTok account. The company site is correctly typed as Company Website.

Sources variously date Owl Creek's creation to 2001 or 2002; the firm says founded in 2002 and Anterix dates the flagship launch to February 2002. Biographies omit a single disputed founding year. Reported performance fees and the continuing manager position support self-created investment wealth, but fund assets are not treated as Altman's personal assets and no net-worth estimate is used.

No reliable evidence establishes a material family launch platform or an independent start without one. Broad Self-made is therefore retained. Bloomberg supports middle name Alan; no precise birth date, birthplace, birth country or second nationality is proposed.

The Florida register's Owl's Nest (2018 Merritt) entity and the exact hull dimensions yield a strong identity bridge. Its Florida registration is inactive, while a separate Owl's Nest entity remains active; neither fact alone proves current beneficial ownership of the vessel. Yacht details are excluded from the public biographies and wealth classifications.

Hedge funds captures his founder-led investment platform; Distressed investing adds its defining strategy and his earlier specialist work. Generic Asset management would overlap these more informative active tags. Anterix securities exposure does not warrant a telecommunications tag.
